known_failures.title: Run-to-run variance
known_failures.detail: Lull's descriptions come from remote models that do not reproduce an answer for a fixed seed (Nemotron 3.5 Lightning ignored the seed in our checks), so the same video gives different cues from one run to the next. Each suite scores one pre-registered run (Suite A: the first complete --all invocation on the final engine) and does not average over runs; the intervals are bootstrapped over videos or reference lines, not over repeated runs.

known_failures.title: Sparse descriptions compared with human audio description
known_failures.detail: Lull says less than a human describer. In the Suite B smoke on Elephants Dream 60-150 s it voiced 55 words per minute (83 with the extended track) against 120 (Silvia Pfeiffer) and 95 (JJ Hunt), and the primary judge credited none of the describers' 46 facts in that clip to its cues. Lull holds or cuts a description it cannot verify against the frames and fits the standard track into the programme's own pauses, which leaves room for far fewer words than a describer who writes for every scene.

known_failures.title: Lecture pauses swallowed before the speech-span fix
known_failures.detail: Before the engine's fix round the listen stage widened narration spans by 0.2-0.6 s and merged sentences across planned pauses of about 1.9 s, so a Suite A lecture had only 4-5 speech-free windows and the standard track voiced little more than slide titles; extended cues froze the picture before their slide appeared. Found in the Suite A smoke (a01, a02, pre-fix engine) and fixed in the engine; the scored run is on the fixed engine and the smoke numbers are not results.

known_failures.title: TTS nondeterminism
known_failures.detail: Magpie TTS returns slightly different audio for the same sentence from one call to the next (seed and temperature parameters did not change that in our checks): a01 re-rendered from an empty cache came out 48.56 s instead of 48.40 s. Suite A's lectures are rendered once and cached (the render tarball reproduces them bit for bit), and Lull's own cue durations vary slightly between runs.

known_failures.title: Elephants Dream (full film) failed in publish
known_failures.detail: The scored recorded run of the full film (final-ed) finished its descriptions (43 verified, 21 held, 43 extended) and then failed while saving keyframes: a cue's keyframe time, 656.3 s, lies after the last video frame of this file (the video stream ends at 653.8 s, the audio at 658.1 s), because the engine bounds keyframe times by the container's duration rather than the video stream's. ffmpeg returned no frame and the run stopped without publishing. A pipeline failure, not re-run: there is no full-film showcase, and Suite B, whose results need all four videos, has no results.
